notes.title: Lufulus' Creatures is Available on Early Access
notes.notes:
RPG Lovers,

I have carefully reviewed your feedback on this game and made another game called [b]Lufulus' Creatures[/b]. In my opinion, Lufulus' Creatures is much more comprehensive and playable. Lufulus' Creatures has been released on Early Access. The game is ready to play. I will read your feedback and make the necessary changes.

I suggest you check out the Early Access description.
I hope you give it a try :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/960220/Lufulus_Creatures/
[b]Discord Channel:[/b] https://discord.gg/ZXRQAws

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26419025/228efd49c0e4e2ffc2aeb8568fdc962a32837b02.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Freezing problem
notes.notes:
If you experience FPS loss,
after re-installing the game, the problem will disappear.

Right Click On Game > Uninstall&Install.
You can install again anytime you want, the problem should be fixed.
It costs maximum 40mb download.

notes.title: UPDATE
notes.notes:
[list]
    [*]MVP Achievement bug has been solved.
    [*]The count of creatures is now balanced. This change prevents FPS loss.
    [*]There are some new creature power/durability balance changes.
    [*]Explosion Arrow bug has been solved.
    [*]Some small mistakes have been corrected.
    [*]The game menu has been slightly upgraded.
[/list]

[b]Collection cards will be added soon.[/b]
Thank you for your feedback.
